strategies.name: Iron condor 970P / 950P × 1030C / 1050C
strategies.rationale: Long-gamma pin + compressed IV + 2 DTE favour a defined-risk short-vol structure that collects the pin decay between the near-money walls.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = wing width (20) − net credit, per side; both wings capped.
strategies.invalidation: A close beyond the 970 put wall or the 1030 call strike breaks the pin thesis — exit.

strategies.name: 990/970 put credit spread
strategies.rationale: Spot above max pain with strong 970 put support; sells the downside toward the pin with capped risk.

S50M26.prediction: Range-bound into expiry, gravitating toward the 990–1010 pin zone; bias neutral. Invalidation: a sustained move outside 970–1030 with rising volume signals the pin has broken.
S50M26.risk_note: Educational only — not trade advice. SET50 options are cash-settled on the index, so pinning is weaker here than for physically-settled single stocks; treat the pin as a tendency, not a guarantee.
